answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel task of self-disclosure abstraction, with the goal of rephrasing disclosure spans into less specific words without losing the utility or essence of the message.

answer_2.quote: We adopt matching BLEU and ROUGE metrics proposed by ... to encourage diversity in generated abstractions.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a human evaluation on 60 sampled self-disclosure test instances. We first use Rank & Rate to rate the abstractions generated from each of the nine models in Table  on a scale of 0-100. Each instance receives three ratings from three in-house annotators.
answer_4.guideline: rate the abstractions on a scale of 0-100; evaluate on four aspects: privacy increase, utility preservation, diversity, and coherence
